commits.message:
mit-trueness-jj1.2: ignore viewport-variant contact sheets (contact-sheet*/) (#50)

Small-viewport verification pass (360x640). Generalize the verification-artifact
ignore from contact-sheet/ to contact-sheet*/ so the 360px sheet and any future
viewport variant stay out of the styles-only repo — one pattern, single source
[LAW:single-enforcer].

No styles change: the 360x640 contact sheet shows every scene legible, captions
unclipped, zero horizontal overflow. The small-viewport cut-plan was already in
place (--type-* clamp() floors + the @media 720/480 seam-token overrides); this
ticket turned that unverified claim into a checked fact [LAW:verifiable-goals].
Full run logged in AGENTS.md (machine-local instrument log).
